name: vLLM
description: vLLM is a high-throughput, memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API (/v1) so existing OpenAI clients can serve local models.

app_vars.name: var_model
app_vars.label: Model
app_vars.help: HuggingFace model id, downloaded on first service start

app_vars.name: var_hf_token
app_vars.label: HuggingFace Token
app_vars.help: Only needed for gated or private models

app_vars.name: var_api_key
app_vars.label: API Key
app_vars.help: Clients must send it as a bearer token. Empty means no authentication

app_vars.name: var_dtype
app_vars.label: Data Type
app_vars.help: Cards older than Ampere have no bfloat16 - pick float16 there

app_vars.name: var_vram_utilization
app_vars.label: VRAM Utilization
app_vars.help: Fraction of GPU memory vLLM may reserve. Lower it when the card is shared

app_vars.name: var_max_model_len
app_vars.label: Max Model Length
app_vars.help: Context window. Empty uses the model's own maximum, which may not fit in VRAM

app_vars.name: INSTALL_NVIDIA_DRIVERS
app_vars.label: Install NVIDIA driver libraries
app_vars.help: Set to no when you install a matching driver in the container yourself

notes.text: Without an API key the API accepts requests from anyone. Set VLLM_API_KEY in /opt/vllm/vllm.env (clients send it as a bearer token) and run systemctl restart vllm.
Pass a GPU through when creating the container. CPU-only inference is impractically slow.
The model downloads from HuggingFace on first start. Change it, HF_TOKEN (gated models) or extra flags (VLLM_SERVE_ARGS) in /opt/vllm/vllm.env, then run systemctl restart vllm.
